description: Check a dependency before you install it. Submit a package and version plus its ecosystem: returns whether that exact version exists, whether it is yanked or deprecated, and every advisory OSV lists against it. An invented version returns not_found with the real versions nearest to it, and an invented name returns the published names that look like it — which is the point, because that is how slopsquatting gets installed. Not a security audit. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

ecosystem.description: Which registry to ask. Defaults to npm.

package.description: The package to check, e.g. 'express', 'express@4.18.2' or '@scope/name'.

name: verify_package
